description: This file contains implementation of NGAP validator functions for PDU session resource setup and modification requests, including duplicate detection, unsupported session type checks, and QoS validation.

methods.name: verify_pdu_session_resource_setup_request
methods.description: Validates and processes a PDU session resource setup request, checking for duplicates, unsupported types, and QoS constraints.

methods.description: Validates and processes a PDU session resource modify request, primarily checking for duplicate session IDs.
